messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT — anomalous outbound webhook traffic from svc-webhook-consumer-2 to https://thirdparty.example.com/ingest detected. 750 req/min with Authorization header present. Sampled payloads contain user identifiers. Triggered at 2026-03-20T10:12:00Z.

alice: oncall here, grabbing context. Are requests coming from prod only? any customer impact?

pagerbot: traffic seen from prod region-us-east-1 only. rate spike started ~10:10Z. auth header pattern matches internal svc token format (svcacct-****). No 5xxs.

ben: @alice assigning sec-eng. Please tag me. I'll pull logs and verify header exposure.

alice: @ben on it. @carol can you pause the webhook consumer or restrict egress to that endpoint?

carol: pausing consumer now — toggling outgoing rule for svc-webhook-consumer-2 -> deny to thirdparty.example.com, will keep service running but queueing.

carol: done. egress rule applied at ~10:16Z. traffic dropped to baseline.

ben: grabbing sampled logs. suspicious header values look like long-lived svc tokens. here's a redacted snippet:```
[2026-03-20T10:11:52Z] svc-webhook-consumer-2 -> POST https://thirdparty.example.com/ingest 
Authorization: Bearer svcacct-ABCD...XYZ
payload: {"user_id":"u-12345","event":"profile_update","metadata":"..."}
```

alice: ok — tokens appear to be service account tokens. Scope? which key store holds these?

ben: seems they are signed by internal token service (authn-svc). Token issuer: authn-prod-1. Checking token issuance logs now.

ben: issuance logs show token created 2025-12-01 and rotated never. Service principal: svc/webhook-consumer-2. Last used repeatedly.

dave: any chance customer PII leaked? payload has user_id, maybe email in some samples. Need to prep comms if yes.

ben: samples include user_id and sometimes email hash. Hard to know bulk exposure — third-party received ~4500 distinct events during spike before we paused. Mark as potential data exposure.

alice: action list: 1) rotate svc-webhook-consumer-2 credentials immediately 2) audit token issuance and other tokens for same principal 3) legal/PS notified for potential customer impact 4) preserve full logs & evidence.

carol: I'll rotate the service principal credentials in keystore and redeploy with new token. performing rotation now.

carol: rotation complete at 10:24Z. New token injected to consumer via secret-manager rollout.

ben: I'm issuing a targeted revoke for the old token and invalidating cached tokens at authn-svc. Command run:```
# revoke token id: svcacct-ABCD...XYZ
curl -X POST https://authn-prod-1.internal/revoke -d '{"token":"svcacct-ABCD...XYZ"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```

ben: revoke returned 200 at 10:26Z. Authn cache TTL flush requested across regions.

alice: preserving snapshots of egress traffic and payload samples — @legal-bot please advise on disclosure requirements.

legal-bot: Received. Please compile affected customer count, types of fields in payloads, and confirm whether full emails or hashed variants were included. We'll coordinate data subject notifications if required.

ben: early numbers: ~4500 events, ~1200 unique user_ids, ~300 payloads with email-like strings (some hashed). I'll run a deeper scan and share CSV in sec-s3.

carol: confirm no further egress after deny + rotation. We'll keep the deny in place until Canaries pass.

alice: who will own customer comms? @dave can you draft a provisional message for CS review? include timeline, mitigations, and next steps.

dave: on it. Draft ETA 45m. Will flag high-risk customers.

ben: follow-ups for infra: check if any other service principals have unrotated long-lived tokens. I found ~8 principals with tokens older than 90 days. Suggest org-wide sweep.

alice: prioritize sweep after containment. Create ticket and assign to infra-team.

carol: created ticket INF-2026-143 sweep + short-lived token policy enforcement.

ben: evidence saved to s3://sec-evidence/3580012345/ (access limited). hash: sha256:abcd1234...

alice: next: schedule postmortem, include sec, infra, devex, cs, legal. Immediate: monitor for any replay attempts from other endpoints. Set IDS signatures for observed token patterns.

carol: IDS rule deployed at 10:40Z. Alerting to sec-channel and oncall.

dave: customer draft queued, will share to this thread before sending.

alice: thanks everyone. I'll keep this thread updated. If anyone finds further evidence, paste samples here but keep PII redacted. :white_check_mark:

pagerbot: Incident closed to active egress at 10:40Z after mitigation steps. Follow-up: postmortem and external comms.
